Or, forgo the Velcro straps and choose the optional Shoulder Strap; it is adjustable from 27" to 51" (with a 11.5" to 24" drop) Proof that good things do come in small packages.

name: Whalemouth X-Small
description: A zipper one and a half times as long as the bag gives you access to every square inch of its interior. It features sturdy 1000 Denier Nylon fabric for its exterior. The seatbelt web strap with a heavy duty Rock Lockster buckle eliminates D-rings and swivels. When the strap is buckled and tightened it also acts as a second layer of closure. Lining is a 400 D Pack cloth which is water resistant.

name: Yoga Duffle
description: The perfect balance of simple, durable, and efficient. The Yoga Duffel features a 1000 D Nylon shell, 400 D Pack cloth lining, exterior/interior pockets, and a removable strap for use in your practice.

name: 18L Packable Backpack
description: The 18L Packable Backpack lives for crowded markets, misty jungle walks, and last-minute detours. Lightweight and weatherproof, it shakes off rain, looks dialed anywhere, and disappears into its own pocket until next time.

name: 18L Personal Item Travel Pack
description: Big bag features, personal item size — The 18L Personal Item Travel Pack is a game changer for short trips and light packers. Fully featured, thoughtfully designed, and purpose-built to fly for free.

name: 18L Waterproof Packable Backpack
description: The 18L Waterproof Packable Backpack lives for bold trips with bad weather, dusty trails, and busy streets. Ultralight and technical, it’s designed to keep your gear dry, look good anywhere, and disappear into its own pocket when the day’s done.

name: 24L Adventure Pack
description: A true everyday pack — built for every type of day you care to throw at it. The 24L Adventure Pack pulls its weight in the backcountry, the boardroom, and the overhead bin.

name: 24L Tote Pack
description: Full days or faraway places — the 24L Tote Pack is perfect for both. With three ways to carry and flexible organization, it goes anywhere and does way more than it lets on.

name: 2L Lite Sling
description: The 2L Lite Sling is purposefully simple. It stays out of the way and delivers exactly what you need — quick access to the things you reach for most.

name: 30L Carry-On Travel Pack
description: If there’s one travel pack that does it all — this is it. The 30L Carry-On Travel Pack excels on its own for short trips and light travel, or pairs seamlessly with rolling luggage when you need more space. Fully featured, thoughtfully designed, and sized to fly.

name: 30L Packable Duffel
description: The 30L Packable Duffel is built to haul — then disappear. Ultralight and weatherproof, it carries the extra gear you did or didn’t plan for, and takes up nearly no space of its own.

name: 35L Global Travel Pack
description: If you’re jumping time zones with everything on your back, the 35L Global Travel Pack is the one you want. Carry-on friendly* with smart organization, unmatched carry comfort, and a dialed design built for the long haul. Also available in 45L.

name: 45L Global Travel Pack
description: If you’re crossing continents with everything on your back, the 45L Global Travel Pack is the one you want. Carry-on friendly* with smart organization, unmatched carry comfort, and a dialed design built for the long haul. Also available in 35L.

name: 45L SEG Hybrid Travel Pack
description: If you crave organization, the 45L SEG Hybrid Travel Pack is going to change the way you travel. The segmented design works like packing cubes, but with quick external access. A rugged build takes you from dusty backroads to overhead bins — and everywhere in between.

name: Gear Cube Set 3-Pack
description: The Gear Cube Set is built for grab-and-go organization. Top-loading cubes open wide, zip shut, and compress fast. Sort clothing, shoes, and gear, then drop them in your pack or use them solo.

name: Packing Cube Set 3-Pack
description: The Packing Cube Set keeps your bag organized with three sizes, see-through mesh panels, and high-vis interiors that make contents easy to spot.

name: Camera Base Layer
description: The Camera Base Layer protects compact DSLR and mirrorless cameras from the elements while keeping them instantly accessible — so you never miss the shot.

name: FlatPak Dry Bag - 2L
description: The FlatPak™ Dry Bag is fully welded and IPX7 rated, sealing out water to keep your gear dry when it counts. 2-liter capacity is ideal for small electronics, technical layers, or anything else that needs to stay dry.

name: FlatPak Dry Bag - 8L
description: The FlatPak™ Dry Bag is fully welded and IPX7 rated, sealing out water to keep your gear dry when it counts. 8-liter capacity is ideal for small electronics, insulated layers, or anything else that needs to stay dry.

name: FlatPak Travel Soap Bar Case
description: The FlatPak™ Travel Soap Bar Case takes the hassle out of traveling with bar soap. It seals in the mess and dries your soap through the fabric — clean, leakproof, and borderline magic.

name: FlatPak Waterproof Toiletry Case
description: The FlatPak™ Waterproof Toiletry Case keeps leaks in and water out. Fully welded with a rolltop closure, it’s built to handle shampoo spills and rain alike.

name: FlatPak Zipper Toiletry Case
description: The FlatPak™ Zipper Toiletry Case keeps your kit contained and protected. Welded construction and a water-resistant zipper create a light, packable barrier against unwanted spills and splashes.

name: Global Travel Stash
description: Low profile, locked down, and in-reach. The Global Travel Stash keeps track of your passport, cards, cash, and keys, so you can focus on the good stuff.

name: Laptop Base Layer
description: The Laptop Base Layer is a padded, waterproof sleeve that keeps your laptop protected for travel and everyday carry.

name: Mesh Organizer Bag Set
description: The Mesh Organizer Bag Set tames the small stuff — chapstick, earplugs, charging cables, all the essentials that tend to disappear. Three see-through pouches, one less thing to worry about.

name: Packable Laundry Bag
description: The Matador Packable Laundry Bag keeps yesterday's adventure off tomorrow's big plans. Lightweight and tough, it disappears into its own pocket until you need it. Hang it, zip it, or lay it flat — wherever you end up, it keeps the laundry in check.

name: Axiom S2 VX Pack
description: Streamlined evolution of the Axiom platform, built around top-down access for constrained spaces such as airplane and car seats. High-aspect back panel for airflow, side-panel access to both the main and laptop compartments, and full-height vertical pockets in the admin and main compartments. VX-21 shell over VX-03 lining.

name: FAST Pack EDC
description: A return to the celebrated 2019 configuration of the FAST Pack EDC, with extensive PALS webbing, integrated organization and a highly adaptable layout. 1000 and 500 denier Cordura, Evazote closed-cell foam, DRI-LEX Aerospacer mesh, Hypalon reinforcements and a removable HDPE frame sheet.

name: Parallax Messenger Bag 15L WX
description: Understated everyday-carry messenger reimagined in TexWax Canvas Duck - a 12oz blend of 85% cotton and 15% CORDURA nylon, 16.6oz after waxing, that is weather resistant, breathable, repairable and develops a patina with use. Padded back and bottom, upper Helix attachment rail, two large side pockets.

name: Control Panel 2 VX
description: Modular organization platform that lets you pack, orient and swap gear loadouts as a unit. A full-length slot pocket takes tablets, documents, notebooks, e-readers or a small hydration bladder, and the included removable HDPE frame sheet adds rigidity to structureless bags such as the Azimuth Pack. VX-21 ripstop shell.

name: OP1 LT VX
description: OP-Series pouch for organizing everyday-carry and survival items so critical tools stay stored but reachable. The LT mounting system stacks webbing vertically and horizontally, so it is no longer limited to PALS/MOLLE and can mount to straps or webbing in virtually any orientation. Dimension Polyant VX21 shell, VX03 liner.

name: Transport Sleeve Small
description: Padded sleeve that protects and transports tablets, laptops and e-readers and integrates with TAD carry systems. Small fits devices and laptops up to a 13in screen. VX-21 RS shell in black, self liner, Hypalon reinforcement.

name: Transport Sleeve Medium
description: Padded sleeve that protects and transports tablets, laptops and e-readers and integrates with TAD carry systems. Medium fits most common 14in, 14.5in and 14.6in laptops, and a 15in MacBook Air. VX-21 RS shell in black, self liner, Hypalon reinforcement.

name: Transport Sleeve Large
description: Padded sleeve that protects and transports tablets, laptops and e-readers and integrates with TAD carry systems. Large fits common laptops up to a 16in screen, and the rear document pocket takes a 12.9in iPad Pro. VX-21 RS shell in black, self liner, Hypalon reinforcement.

name: Transport Cube Viewport Small
description: Weather-resistant packing cube with a rugged clear window for identifying contents at a glance. Zippered clamshell opening; mounts to Helix-equipped containers, MOLLE and PALS webbing, or works on its own. Small measures 7.5in W x 5.5in T x 4in D. Dimension Polyant VX21.

name: Transport Cube Viewport Medium
description: Weather-resistant packing cube with a rugged clear window for identifying contents at a glance. Zippered clamshell opening; mounts to Helix-equipped containers, MOLLE and PALS webbing, or works on its own. Medium measures 9.5in W x 7in T x 4in D. Dimension Polyant VX21.

name: Transport Cube Viewport Large
description: Weather-resistant packing cube with a rugged clear window for identifying contents at a glance. Zippered clamshell opening; mounts to Helix-equipped containers, MOLLE and PALS webbing, or works on its own. Large measures 13.5in W x 10in T x 4in D. Dimension Polyant VX21.

name: Apex Backpack 4.0
description: Made for makers. The award-winning Apex 4.0 combines clever interior organisation and clean design with incredible comfort. With soft, contouring backstraps, smart weight distribution, and a sleek profile, the Apex 4.0 is perfect for city-commutes, travel, and everything in between. We called it the Apex because we put everything we’ve ever learned into the design, aiming to produce a truly unbeatable piece of kit. You could say we’re pretty proud of it.

name: Apex Compact Backpack 4.0
description: The Apex Compact is for those who need a minimalist carry that delivers capacity precisely on target. No more than you need, to make travel and commute simple and easy. The Compact combines clever interior organisation and smart weight distribution with a clean profile, ideal for traversing the urban world every single day.

name: Apex Slim Backpack
description: Built for the essentials, with zero wasted space. The Slim is the ideal Apex for those with smaller frames, or for minimalist everyday carry. Lighter, slimmer, but made with the same premium craftsmanship and obsession over materials you expect. We’ve removed the exterior water bottle pockets to add a clamshell zip, improving access and giving you a silhouette tailored specifically to be sleeker.

name: Apex Mini
description: The perfect choice when there’s less to pack.

name: Apex Travel Backpack
description: The Apex Travel Backpack gives you maximum space without checking a bag. With 33L of everyday capacity, it expands by 9 cm / 3.5 inches in depth to 42L when you need more — and meets carry-on requirements on most major airlines.

name: Contour Backpack
description: The Contour holds the load high and close to your spine, so a full bag drags less on your shoulders. The sculpted back panel and ergonomic straps are proportioned for the female shoulder. The rear CrashPad Cocoon laptop section keeps tech protected and balances the load from the moment you pick it up.

name: Elemental Backpack
description: Built from a proprietary fabric engineered for sustained exposure, the Elemental moves from airport to trailhead without asking you to compromise.

name: Generation Leather Backpack
description: Leather – reinvented. Lightweight and durable European calfskin, tanned more sustainably. Cleverly designed for organising your daily essentials, it’s a pleasure to wear, ergonomically designed for all-day comfort. Perfect for business and casual trips.

name: Matrix Backpack
description: Meet the Matrix Backpack: This is a mission-ready companion, with a precision-designed storage system that keeps your tech locked, loaded, and within easy reach. Fold down the entire front pocket to reveal your mobile office.

name: Neo Backpack
description: The Neo Backpack is designed for everyday life in motion: whether you’re heading to the office, catching a late-night train or hopping on a weekend flight. With a clean, relaxed silhouette and featherlight construction, it keeps pace with whatever’s next. Inside, intuitive compartments make tech, hydration and essentials easy to grab on the go: no digging, no stress.

name: Pioneer Backpack
description: Most bags are designed for one version of the day. This one is designed for all of them. Commute to overnight. Desk to gym. Gate to carry-on. The transitions happen — this bag just doesn't make them harder. A dedicated shoe compartment keeps the chaos contained. More pockets and a larger capacity mean your essentials are where you left them. New ergonomic S-sculpted straps wrap in lightweight, waterproof fabric made from recycled plastic bottles, so the weight disappears, even when the day doesn't.

name: Apex Briefcase
description: Workplaces, working hours and office wardrobes have evolved. Now the briefcase has, too.

name: Apex Everyday Duffle
description: The functionality and comfort of our award-winning Apex Backpack – in a duffle. Perfect for every day, from work to gym to overnight escapes. A separate shoe compartment keeps your gear clean. Complete with detachable, super-comfy shoulder strap.

name: Apex Travel Duffle
description: Inspired by the innovative design, tough materials and versatility of our best-selling Apex Backpack. Expandable capacity gives you the adaptability to pack more – planned or unplanned! With a detachable, super-comfy shoulder strap.

name: Elemental Duffle
description: Made for those who move between the natural and urban worlds.

name: Generation Leather Duffle
description: Leather – but not as you know it. Lightweight and durable European calfskin, tanned more sustainably. Engineered for easy organisation and intuitive access to your gear, this bag works equally well for business and casual trips.

name: Buddy Case
description: Pack more into a smaller space. Whether you’re packing tech accessories or toiletries, your essentials are easy to reach. Made from an innovative non-crease fabric, this compact case can be compressed into your bag and emerge looking immaculate.

name: Caboodle Case
description: Clever organisation for intuitive access. Smarter storage makes it quick and easy to find just what you need, from tech to toiletries. In a lightweight non-crease fabric, this case can be compressed into your bag and emerge looking flawless.

name: Rig Case
description: Big on organisation. Whether you’re packing tech accessories or toiletries, this 4-litre pouch keeps everything within easy reach. In an innovative non-crease fabric, it can be compressed into your bag and emerge looking clean and professional.

name: Elemental Shoe Bag
description: A tapered silhouette makes fitting shoes into a packed bag significantly easier than it has any right to be.

name: Elemental Large Packing Dome
description: The Elemental Large Packing Dome is your ultra-efficient assistant. Offers three-sided expansion or compression depending on how packed your schedule – or bag – is.

name: Elemental Small Packing Dome
description: Built from the same proprietary Elemental fabric engineered for the elements — because even the smallest piece of kit should be ready for the conditions.

name: Apex Sling
description: Liberate your pockets. Hands-free carrying, clever storage and all-day comfort, with an easy-to-adjust strap for left-handed or right-handed users. It holds larger items too, like a water bottle or small tablet, creating more packing opportunities. Explore the Apex Collection.

name: Elemental Sling
description: For the ones who need their essentials by their side, always.

name: Apex Everyday Tote
description: Light and easy to carry, with room where it counts — deep pockets for a laptop, tech, and the small essentials that somehow multiply midweek. The laptop sits secure behind a padded Velcro tab. Two quick-dry gusset bottle pockets mean hydration doesn't become a logistics problem.

name: Arc Tote Backpack
description: The bag that looks right in the room rarely feels right on the shoulder. The Arc refuses that trade-off: a slim, considered tote profile, with smart organisation inside. Features a separate rear CrashPad Cocoon laptop compartment, FortiWeave fabric, vegan leather trims, and ergonomic straps that disappear behind the bag when not in use.

name: Elemental Gear Tote
description: Simple design. Serious capacity. Folds down into a compact rectangle when not in use — small enough to slip inside a suitcase, backpack, or bag without taking up space you need for something else.

name: Elemental Tote
description: Made for those who want to seize the moment. Surprisingly tough, the Elemental Tote blurs the line between fun and utility, giving you the best of both worlds, featuring a new proprietary and sustainable fabric that protects your gear from wear and water.

name: Rambler Tote
description: Quietly iconic: Crafted from super‑tough FortiWeave 600D fabric with refined vegan leather trims, the Rambler Tote is a lightweight, stand‑up work tote designed to move seamlessly between office, travel and daily life.

name: Authority Laptop Backpack Deluxe
description: A monster of a work pack in premium materials, the Authority Pack DLX will keep you organized and ready to work at home or away.

name: Canvas Shop Tote Bag
description: Simple doesn’t always mean basic. And that’s especially true with our Canvas Shop Tote.

name: Classic Messenger Bag Large
description: From a dream to a sketch to a bag. And now ... an icon. It’s been over 30 years since our first messenger hit the streets in 1989, and we’re moving its legendary design forward.

name: Classic Messenger Bag Medium
description: From a dream to a sketch to a bag. And now ... an icon. It’s been over 30 years since our first messenger hit the streets in 1989, and we’re moving its legendary design forward.

name: Classic Messenger Bag Small
description: From a dream to a sketch to a bag. And now ... an icon. It’s been over 30 years since our first messenger hit the streets in 1989, and we’re moving its legendary design forward.

name: Classic Messenger Bag X-Small
description: From a dream to a sketch to a bag. And now ... an icon. It’s been over 30 years since our first messenger hit the streets in 1989, and we’re moving its legendary design forward.

name: Closer Laptop Briefcase
description: Closer is for those who don’t want to, but need to carry a briefcase. It holds most of your office, but is streamlined. Like our legendary Commute Messenger, the Closer Case is full of tricks.

name: Commute Messenger Bag 2.0
description: Based off of our original Commute Messenger Bag, the Commute 2.0 is our hardest working workhorse. Designed to totally protect your laptop, tablet, and phone while making it easy to actually use them, the Commute 2.0 is solid on game-changing details.

name: Division Laptop Backpack Deluxe
description: An update to one of our best-selling backpacks, the Division Deluxe is a highly organized work pack with premium materials and features.

name: Flight Backpack
description: Lightweight, durable, and loaded with useful pockets, the Flight Backpack is ready for everything from your daily commute, to a weekend filled with outdoor adventures.

name: Flight Classic Messenger Bag Large
description: A lightweight bag with heavyweight features, Flight is ready for nonstop adventures.

name: Flight Classic Messenger Bag Medium
description: A lightweight bag with heavyweight features, Flight is ready for nonstop adventures.

name: Flight Convertible Tote Backpack
description: Our Flight Convertible Tote Pack is a tasteful blend of style and sustainability. Constructed with eco-friendly yarns and recycled polyester made from pre-consumer waste, it’s an environmentally friendly tote that looks (and feels) good.

name: Flight Crossbody Satchel
description: Wearable as a crossbody or shoulder bag, the Flight Crossbody Satchel is a great solution for those times when all you need to carry are the essentials.

name: Flight Crossbody Sling Bag
description: Constructed from an eco-friendly, recycled polyester that's made from pre-consumer waste, the Flight Sling is a fashionable blend of style and functionality.

name: Foundry Pack
description: A premium waxed canvas and leather backpack, the Foundry is designed for daily commuting and the occasional out of office meeting.

name: Long Haul 2-in-1 Duffel
description: Designed for movement, not just transport, the Long Haul 2-in-1 Duffel is built for the trips where the path isn’t paved and your gear needs to stay protected through it all.

name: Long Haul Duffel 80L
description: Engineered for durability, designed for movement. The Long Haul Duffel combines utility-driven performance with a clean, elevated aesthetic. Constructed from 100% ballistic Cordura nylon, this bag is as tough as it is timeless.

name: Mode Backpack
description: Designed for the style-driven, the Mode Daypack blends clean lines and refined function, making every move look intentional. Constructed from nylon twill, this pack delivers both structure and softness.

name: Mode Belt Bag
description: Designed for life on the go, this sleek belt bag keeps pace with your every move, whether it’s a morning run, city errand, or airport connection. Crafted from 100% nylon twill and featuring YKK zippers, it’s where performance meets polish.

name: Mode Weekender Bag
description: The Mode Weekender is the sweet spot between getaway and carry-on - streamlined, versatile, and built to keep pace. Crafted from durable nylon twill with bonded leather details, it blends modern utility with elevated design.

name: Never Check Expandable Backpack
description: A laptop pack that grows, the Expandable backpack is a carry-on dream come true. Quick access external pockets and a gusseted main compartment zipper with securing hooks mean you can both grab and stuff very quickly, while front pocket organization helps restore calm.

name: Packable Travel Tote
description: Roomy, highly functional, and made from a water-repellent, fully wipeable material, the Packable Tote is an essential companion for the savvy traveler. Both the interior and exterior zip pockets work great for storing a wallet, keys, and phone.

name: Parkside Laptop Backpack 2.0
description: An update to one of our best-selling laptop backpacks, the Parkside is loaded with useful organization and well-suited for anyone, from campus to the boardroom. Multiple front pockets are great for storing a tablet and headphones, to charging cables, keys and a phone.

name: Player Duffel Bag
description: Road trip ready and built for the long-haul, the Player is perfectly suited to be your go-to gym bag. The roomy main compartment is ideal for stowing workout clothes and a light jacket.

name: Q Laptop Backpack 2.0
description: An updated and improved version of a backpack that’s beloved by students and office warriors alike, the Q 2.0 is a mid-sized backpack that’s fully-loaded with all the organization that your gear needs.

name: Relo Backpack 40L
description: Made from 100% Cordura® ballistic nylon, the Relo is designed for lasting durability. Waterproof zippers, a molded back panel, and ergonomic shoulder straps keep you comfortable and protected through any trip.

name: Scheme Convertible Briefcase Backpack
description: Designed for savvy and mobile professionals, the Scheme offers the multifunctional flexibility to morph from a briefcase to a backpack. Both the shoulder and backpack straps are removable, so wear it your way based on the workload of the day.

name: Scholar Convertible Tote Backpack
description: Academics and intellectuals alike know that flexibility is key. Sure, the Scholar is a tote, but for those times when you need your arms back, simply untuck the hidden straps and carry it as a backpack.

name: Slacker Chest Pack
description: Sometimes you need to keep things uncomplicated and simply tote around the essentials. The Slacker is ready, able, and certainly no slouch. The main compartment is perfect for storing your keys, cash, cards, and sunglasses.

name: Spirit Laptop Backpack
description: The Spirit blends classic form with modern, durable function. For your haul to class or the office, it fits most 13” laptops, your set of notebooks, and a light change of clothes in the interior compartment. One front and one side pocket house smaller items on the exterior.

name: Stealth Folio Organizer X-Large
description: A protective case with contemporary styling, this accessory begs to be carried in your hand, but will agree to sit inside a bag, for a moment. Sized to fit a laptop, cords, phone, it carries and protects everything you really need.

name: Transit Dopp Kit
description: Whether you’re packing for a long weekend out of town or taking that well-deserved vacation, the Transit Dopp Kit is a toiletry bag that keeps you organized and on the move.

name: Tuck Laptop Backpack
description: A minimalist tech bag. A cycling road-warrior. An urban grocery-hauler. The redesigned Tuck Pack has just enough organization for your daily commute and ample capacity for weekend excursions. Rear-access laptop compartment is padded for safety.

name: Wingman Travel Backpack Duffel
description: Loaded with a bevy of useful features and able to be worn in a variety of ways, the Wingman Travel Backpack Duffel is destined to become your go-to travel companion.

name: Urban Ghost 20L Backpack
description: Low-profile 20L EDC pack in 420D poly-carbonate-coated ripstop nylon, with a loop-lined concealed-carry compartment reached by a Rapid Access half-pull tab, lockable YKK zippers and a luggage pass-through.

name: Urban Ghost 10L Sling Bag
description: 10L ripstop sling with a 39-inch main-compartment zipper opening, loop-lined CCW compartment and ambidextrous strap routing.

name: Urban Ghost Weekender 36L Travel Bag
description: Carry-on-friendly 36L weekender with stowable shoulder straps, a luggage pass-through, locking YKK zippers, a front admin compartment and a dedicated tablet sleeve.

name: Urban Ghost DOPP Kit
description: Ripstop dopp kit with elastic retention bands, a large transparent mesh pocket, an internal key lanyard point and a tuck-away hanger strap.

name: Urban Ghost Utility Pouch
description: Clamshell utility pouch opening a full 180 degrees, with double-layer interior pockets, mesh storage, stretch dividers and a removable key lanyard.

name: Go Pack
description: Packable 210D nylon ripstop drawstring pack with airmesh shoulder straps, contoured shoulder pads, a top grab handle and a Hypalon quick-release pull tab; sized to fit the SOCP panel.

name: Siege 35L Tactical Backpack
description: 35L tactical pack in 330D nylon with a 500D laser-cut MOLLE expandable front pocket, a fully loop-lined EDC compartment, YKK locking zippers and a waist belt for heavier loads.

name: Siege 25L Tactical Backpack
description: 25L tactical pack in 330D nylon with a 500D laser-cut MOLLE expandable front pocket, loop-lined EDC compartment behind the front panel and a waist belt for heavier loads.

name: Siege 15L Tactical Sling
description: Ambidextrous 15L sling in 330D nylon with a 500D laser-cut MOLLE expandable front pocket and two loop-lined EDC compartments behind the front panel.

name: Gamut 32L Backpack
description: 32L EDC pack with a repositionable Rapid Access pull tab, a spacious CCW compartment with an integrated Large BAP strap, a stowable gear sling and hydration pass-through ports.

name: Gamut 26L Backpack
description: 26L EDC pack with a repositionable Rapid Access pull tab, CCW compartment with an integrated Large BAP strap, a hidden sling pocket and a stowable gear sling.

name: Gamut 22L Backpack
description: 22L EDC pack in 500D nylon with a repositionable Rapid Access pull tab, CCW compartment with an integrated Large BAP strap and a stowable gear sling.

name: Gamut 22L Sling
description: 22L sling in 500D nylon with Gatekeeper G-hooks over the CCW compartment, a repositionable Rapid Access pull tab and a stowable gear sling.

name: Gamut 18L Sling
description: 18L sling with Gatekeeper G-hooks over the CCW compartment, a hidden sling pocket for low-visibility storage and a repositionable Rapid Access pull tab.

name: Any Day Backpack
description: 20L water-resistant nylon daypack with a Micro Rapid Access pull tab, two external front zip pockets, a light-coloured interior and a loop-lined padded laptop sleeve fitting up to 15 inches.

name: Everyday Fanny Pack+
description: 4L water-resistant nylon waist pack with a CCW-compatible main compartment, an included Micro Rapid Access tab and Modular Holster Retention system, and a colour-matched adjustable belt.

name: Everyday Fanny Pack 2.1
description: 2L water-resistant nylon waist pack with a 9 x 5.25 x 2 inch CCW compartment, an included Rapid Access tab and Modular Holster Retention system, and a secure buckle system.

name: Everyday Fanny Pack 2.0
description: 2L nylon waist pack designed with Lena Miculek, with a two-way-zip CCW-compatible main compartment, a loop panel, a discreet back phone pocket and a silicone logo that resists slipping.

name: Ready Pack X
description: 20L pack in 500D and 420D mini-ripstop nylon with a 16.5-inch CCW compartment, an included Large BAP strap, Crossbreed modular holster compatibility and a 15-inch laptop sleeve.

name: Commuter Sling XL 2.0
description: 23L rifle-compatible concealed-carry sling with a loop-lined weapon platform, a 3-D moulded foam back panel, YKK self-repairing coil zippers and room for a 15-inch laptop.

name: S.O.C.P. Tactical Fanny Pack
description: Larger sibling of the S.O.C.P. Sling, sized to conceal an everyday carry load; the external cellphone pocket has a zippered touch-screen window that folds down as a nav board.

name: S.O.C.P. Sling (Updated)
description: Compact 500D Cordura sling built around the S.O.C.P. Dagger, with laser-cut dagger attachment points on the back panel, a hidden rapid-access pocket and clips fitting belts or straps up to 2.25 inches.

name: Transit EDC Sling Bag
description: 17L EDC sling with a convertible front flap that stows behind the laser-cut MOLLE panel, a Gatekeeper G-hook over the CCW compartment, a stabilizer strap and a 15-inch laptop compartment.

name: Basecamp
description: 30L pack with a built-in base that lets it stand unsupported, a main compartment opening 180 degrees, a convertible front flap over laser-cut MOLLE and Gatekeeper G-hooks on the CCW compartment.

name: Ruck Roll

name: Daybreaker 2
description: A 25L ultralight activity backpack made with durable fabrics, and updated for easy access, convenient storage, and comfortable support for any adventure.

name: Thirteen Daybag
description: The Thirteen Daybag is a minimal do-it-all backpack. Compact with surprising capacity and plenty of pockets, the Thirteen is ideal for both busy commutes and leisurely strolls. Fits up to 14" laptops.

name: Max EDC
description: Maximise everyday carry with Max EDC, a 26L backpack with a flexible 3-compartment design, convenient easy access pockets, and ergonomic fit to tackle any occasion. Laptop sleeve fits up to 17" devices.

name: Max Backpack 30L
description: The Ultimate Everyday backpack for work, play, and travel. The fixed-volume member of the Max family, with 30L of smart, efficient storage, engineered carry comfort, and secure features. Fits up to 17" devices.

name: Max Backpack 32L
description: The Ultimate Everyday backpack for work, play, and travel. The expandable member of the Max family: 30 litres that open to 32 with a zipper pull, engineered carry comfort, and secure features. Fits up to 17" devices.

description: A versatile 2.5L sling bag with 2 compartments, Accordion Flex expansion, removable padded straps and easy access pockets. Comes with 1x Core Sling pouch and 1x Core Sling strap.

name: Core Sling Mini
description: A multifunctional 1.5L sling bag with organizers, Accordion Flex expansion, removable webbing straps for use as a sling or tech pouch. Comes with 1x Core Sling Mini pouch and 1x Core Sling Mini strap.

name: Bottle Sling
description: Great for 1L bottles, and so much more. Whether you’re packing an umbrella, snacks, a compact camera, or your daily essentials, this bucket-style sling features three organized pockets, rain holes for spills, and expandable webbing grips.

name: Joey Pouch
description: A Joey (that’s a baby kangaroo) — this little guy will take cards, keys, and other small knickknacks. Made with a water resistant shell, Hypalon detailing, external card slot and a key loop, the Joey clips onto Able Carry backpacks or works as a standalone carrier.

name: Stash Pouch
description: Able Carry’s little carry ninja for keeping pens, toiletries, and loose knick-knacks in check. Comes in X-Pac or Cordura Nylon to match the backpacks.

description: Power up your packing with Cubes. More than simple organisers, Cubes expand and compress for a perfect fit with Able Carry backpacks, or as a standalone kit for gym sessions and beyond. Small measures 18 x 11 x 14.5 cm, expanding to 31.5 x 14 x 14.5 cm.

name: Cube Medium
description: Power up your packing with Cubes. More than simple organisers, Cubes expand and compress for a perfect fit with Able Carry backpacks, or as a standalone kit for gym sessions and beyond. Medium measures 28 x 14 x 11 cm, expanding to 31.5 x 17 x 11 cm.

name: Arc Haul Ultra 40L Backpack
description: The Arc Haul Ultra backpack is designed for comfort and durability at an unbeatable weight. Made from Ultra 100X material, the Arc Haul is innovatively designed for long days between resupply. Whether you are thru-hiking or out for a week, this ultralight backpack is a workhorse from the Sierras to the Smokies. Transfer your pack’s weight to your hips with our curved carbon fiber Arc Frame system, and enjoy the air gap between your back and the pack to keep you cool.

name: Arc Zip Ultra 62L Backpack
description: The Arc Zip Ultra was built from the ground up for hikers who need quick access to their gear and all-day comfort on the trail. The front zip panel lets you grab your food bag or camera gear without digging through your pack. Our signature curved carbon fiber Arc Frame transfers weight to your hips and creates a breathable space between your back and the pack. No more sweaty discomfort during long climbs or hot days. With a patented adjustable torso height, interchangeable shoulder straps, and a padded belt that hugs your shape this ultralight pack is ready to move with you wherever the miles take you.

name: Arc Pro 50L Backpack
description: The Arc Pro is what happens when a proven long-distance backpack gets stripped down and rebuilt around durability, simplicity, and effortless access. Delivering a technical look and serious trail performance, the Arc Pro is made with rugged Ultra TenX fabric and built for the demands of long-distance hiking. Venom Stretch Mesh center, side, and bottom stow pockets keep frequently used gear accessible without adding unnecessary straps or hardware. The pack also includes a zippered 3D mesh pocket that holds a removable sit pad against your back, giving you a comfortable place to stop wherever the trail takes you.

name: Nero Classic Backpack
description: The Nero Classic is as as close as it gets to our original frameless backpack design which was tested on an Appalachian Trail thru-hike over 20 years ago. The Nero is compact and streamlined with only the most essential features for long distance hikers. Bomb-proof Ultra 100X fabric and waterproof taped seams can handle whatever nature throws at it. Gray, Green, Pink, and Red variations feature Ultra TenX fabric for an added pop of color. Choose from multiple volumes to fit your hiking style. Three different interchangeable strap designs, an optional removable belt, a comfy sit pad, and a bunch of cool modular add-ons make the versatile Nero Classic your ticket to maximizing every day hike, section hike, or thru-hike. Sold in 30L, 40L and 50L on one product page; the price, volume and weight here are the 30L base configuration with standard straps and no belt.

name: Nero Pro Backpack
description: Designed for advanced hikers who want their frameless pack to move fast and work hard, the Nero Pro takes the same streamlined, frameless philosophy that makes the Nero Classic a go-to for minimalists, long-distance hikers, and elevates it to technical territory. Featuring premium Ultra TenX fabric and a full set of Stretch-Mesh center, side, and bottom pockets, the pack is purpose-built to give high-use storage areas an advanced balance of stretch, durability, and trail-ready function. Sold in 30L, 40L and 50L on one product page; the price, volume and weight here are the 30L base configuration with standard straps and no belt.

name: Bagger Ultra 25L Backpack
description: The Bagger Ultra 25L is the ultimate small travel backpack to take you from plane, to town, to trail. It is sized to fit under airplane seats and can even count as your personal item on budget airlines. With the right gear list you can bag a peak or two on a daytrip excursion or even do a couple overnights with a Summer Quilt, an ultralight tent, and room to spare. Featuring a small and streamlined design, the Bagger can be packed as a secondary backpack for summit side trips or used as an ultralight minimalist pack for short adventures into the backcountry. The Bagger utilizes an included, easily removable foam sit pad that doubles as a frame and padding against your back. With 3 different interchangeable strap designs, a removable belt, a comfy sit pad, and a bunch of cool modular add-ons, the versatile Bagger Ultra is your ticket to maximizing day hikes, weekend trips, or commutes.

name: Multi-Pack
description: This versatile four-in-one backpack accessory is one of our most popular items. The ability to choose between four different configurations helps make the Multi-Pack the perfect companion for just about any adventure. Need a spare set of Multi-Pack straps? Click here.

name: Front Utility Pack Accessory
description: From the summit to the streets, the versatile Front Utility Pack Accessory provides quick and easy access to all your essentials. With plenty of space for your phone, a camera, a jacket or snacks, the ultralight F.U.P.A. can be worn as a stand-alone item while bagging a peak or for a night out on the town. Leave the webbing belt at home and connect the F.U.P.A. directly to one of our backpacks for the ultimate pack accessory.

name: Belt Pouch
description: Be prepared for whatever the trail may bring by keeping your essentials close in hand with our belt pouches. These pouches clip securely to a padded belt, like on our Arc backpacks. There is plenty of space for a headlamp, folded maps, snacks, hat and gloves, gadgets, you name it. Sold singly or as a pair; the price and weight here are for a single pouch.

name: Shoulder Pouch
description: Shoulder Pouches are the ideal place to keep your small camera or phone in reach for taking quick photos. The main compartment of the shoulder pouches are a good size for your wallet, car keys, map, headlamp, mittens, sunglasses, candy bars, pack towel, GPS, or any other items you would like to have within easy reach. The pouches carry comfortably on your shoulder, and you will hardly notice them there. The small exterior mesh pocket can be used to store your small items like lip balm, emergency whistle, or a compass. Sold singly or as a pair; the price and weight here are for a single pouch.

name: Shoulder Pouch w/ Zipper
description: Designed for the adventurer on the go, our Shoulder Pouch w/ Zipper is the ideal place to store items that you need on the ready, like a small camera, your wallet, a map or your smart phone. The streamlined design carries comfortably on your shoulder, and you will hardly notice them there. The small exterior mesh pocket can be used to store your small items like lip balm, emergency whistle, or a compass. Sold singly or as a pair; the price and weight here are for a single pouch.

name: Top Side Pocket
description: Sometimes an adventure calls for a little extra space. Our modular Top Side Pockets allow you to carry extra gear (like your cooking pot or rain gear) on the outside of your pack while still being able to accommodate taller items (like trekking poles, an umbrella, or a fishing pole) behind the pockets. The pockets have four cords at the corners which can reach up or down to loops on the sides of your backpack, and cinch tight. Our 40L and larger packs have loops, but our smaller backpacks may not- please make sure your pack has suitable attachment points.

name: Packing Cubes
description: Whether its a duffle, a suitcase, or a backpack, our packing cubes are designed to fully utilize all available space; maximizing your carrying potential. Made out of lightweight and durable Dyneema® Composite Fabric, these cubes feature a wrap around webbing closure and compression system that ensures that your clothing and gear take up the minimal amount possible. Find more of our Crossover Collection here. Sold in Small, Medium and Large on one product page; the price, volume and weight here are the Small.

name: Pack Liner
description: This full size roll top dry bag protects the entire internal contents of your backpack. This is a good option if you prefer to use non-waterproof stuff sacks instead of individual dry bags. It is also nice as an extra layer in very wet environments. Multiple sizes are available.This is also available in a heavier material with a handle for dual-use as a protective Airplane Case for checking your backpack on an airplane. Sold in Small, Medium and Large on one product page; the price, volume and weight here are the Small, which fits the main body of a 40L or smaller pack.

name: Airplane Case
description: Our Airplane Travel Case is a useful addition for the jetsetting adventurer looking to blaze international trails. Slide your backpack inside to protect it when checking your backpack on to a plane. When you arrive, move the airplane case to the inside of your backpack and it doubles as a pack liner.This size will fit typical backpacks up to about 60-70L with all items removed from the exterior pockets. We also have an XL Airplane Case with extra space for items in the exterior pockets or beside your pack.

name: XL Airplane Case
description: Our XL Airplane Travel Case is a useful addition for the jetsetting adventurer looking to blaze international trails. Slide your full backpack inside to protect it when checking your backpack on to a plane. When you arrive, move the airplane case to the inside of your backpack and it doubles as a pack liner.The XL size fits 60-70L+ backpacks with space for items in the exterior pockets or beside the backpack. Try our standard size Airplane case for slimmer, smaller backpacks.

name: Travel Utility Zip
description: Our ultralight Travel Utility Zip keeps your most important items secure and in easy reach while on the move. A zippered compartment allows you to keep your essentials organized and features separate internal pockets for your passport, Field Notes, and a pen. The Travel Utility Zip is a great place to keep your phone, plane ticket, cash and headphones while on the go.

name: Itty Bitty Ditty Bag
description: The Itty Bitty Ditty Bag is designed for long-distance hikers who like to keep things light and organized. Made from durable Ultra 100X material, this ultralight powerhouse shrugs off the bumps and bruises of the trail while weighing practically nothing. It’s got space for all your essentials—soap, conditioner, toothbrush, deodorant, hair brush, tampons, you name it—keeping your self-care game on point no matter how far you roam.

name: Water Bottle Sleeve
description: Water Bottle Sleeves are a great way to keep your water easily accessible while also counter-balancing your backpack. Designed to fit most popular tall slim 1L bottles such as Smart Water, Body Armor, Essentia and similar, these sleeves will attach to the shoulder straps on just about any backpack.

name: Document Zip Pouch
description: The Document Zip Pouch is ideal for storing and protecting your maps, data sheets and other travel documents. It may also fit a small laptop. Our zip pouches are the perfect way to keep organized without adding extra ounces to your pack. Durable Ultra 100X Fabric keeps your items protected from water and abrasion. Need a different size? Check out the rest of our Zip Pouch collection.

name: Tablet Zip Pouch
description: The Tablet Zip Pouch is sized to fit most tablets up to about a 7” (18 cm) screen size. Made from durable Ultra 100X Fabric, this pouch is ideal for protecting a tablet from scratches and water when you are on the go. The zip pouch needs to be about an inch wider and taller than the device to fit comfortably.

name: Phablet Zip Pouch
description: Blogging about your hike? The phablet is sized to fit your plus size phone. You can also store your cash, credit cards, and passport in with your phone. Made from durable Ultra 100X Fabric, these pouches are ideal for protecting your valuables from scratches and water. The zip pouch needs to be about an inch wider and taller than the device to fit comfortably. Need a different size? Check out the rest of our Zip Pouch collection.

name: Phone Zip Pouch
description: Keep your mind off your phone and on the trail. Made from durable Ultra 100X Fabric, the Phone Zip is ideal for protecting a standard size smart phone from scratches and water. You can also store your cash, credit cards, and passport in with your phone. If you have a plus size phone, or a bulky case consider the Phablet Zip Pouch. The zip pouch needs to be about an inch wider and taller than the device to fit comfortably.

name: Passport Zip Pouch
description: When you’re traveling abroad, our Passport Zip Pouch is the ideal accessory for storing your passport, credit cards, plane ticket, and international cash. Made from durable Ultra 100X Fabric, these pouches will keep your important items organized and protected.For even more versatility on the move, check out our Travel Zip Pouch which has two compartments and a neck lanyard to keep it close. Need a different size? Check out the rest of our Zip Pouch collection.

name: Wallet Zip Pouch
description: The Wallet Zip Pouch is a good fit for folded cash, credit cards, and change. The pouch is made from Ultra 100 Fabric which is so durable that Hikelighter.com named it a top pick after over 6 years and 2,000+ days of use! All of our zip pouches have loops so you can add a leash or carabiner if desired. Need a different size? Check out the rest of our Zip Pouch collection.

name: Glasses Zip Pouch
description: When you’re packing for your next big hike, leave your bulky glasses case at home. Our glasses zip pouch is the perfect solution for true minimalist hikers looking to shed every ounce they can. Made from durable Ultra 100X Fabric, this pouch is ideal for protecting your reading glasses or sunglasses from scratches. This pouch is also a good size for un-folded cash, and could be used as a full length wallet. Need a different size? Check out the rest of our Zip Pouch collection.

name: Stick-on Key Zip Pouch
description: Make sure you don’t lose your most important items. Attach this stick-on key zip pouch to the inside of your backpack, and your keys, wallet, passport, smartphone or other valuables will still be where you left them at the end of your hike. When you get to town the pouch detaches and fits in your pocket. Just peel off the brown paper backing from the included flat clips and attach the pouch inside your backpack where you want it. We usually stick it towards the top of the backpack right behind the shoulder straps so that it is easy to get to. The adhesive bonds well and will also work on any urethane coated backpack material. Spare Stick on Flat Clips are available if you want to clip this pouch to a second location.

name: Ultralight Sunglasses Case w/ Microfiber Cloth
description: Protect your investment with our Ultralight Sunglasses Case. Sleek, minimalist protection made from durable ripstop nylon with a soft Octa fleece lining to keep lenses scratch-free on trail or in town. A built-in hang loop makes it easy to clip to your pack, belt loop, or bike for quick access, while the magnetic clasp keeps everything securely closed. A microfiber cleaning cloth is included, and stores conveniently in the stretchy Lycra pocket. The cleaning cloth stays attached to a small loop inside the pocket so that it never gets lost.

name: Jääkäri XL backpack
description: External tubular aluminium frame rucksack in 1000D Cordura, 70 litres, with a roll-top main compartment under a floating lid, height-adjustable carrying system, padded removable hip belt and full PALS webbing.

name: Jääkäri L backpack
description: 55-litre 1000D Cordura rucksack descended from the 1980s Finnish Border Guard Border Patrol pack, with an internal tubular aluminium frame, floating lid, bottom zipper, hydration compartment and padded removable hip belt.

description: 30-litre 1000D Cordura daypack with an internal frame sheet, floating lid, side zipper into the main compartment, hydration sleeve and PALS webbing. Issued under NSN 8465-58-002-0194.

name: Jääkäri S backpack
description: 20-litre 1000D Cordura daypack with a folding lid, low-profile webbing shoulder straps, internal hydration compartment and side compression straps. Issued under NSN 8465-58-002-0193.

description: 60-litre roll-top main pack plus a 12-litre floating lid (72 litres total) in 1000D and 500D Cordura, on an internal tubular aluminium frame, with load-lifter shoulder straps, a PALS hip belt and bellowed side pouches.

name: Kantamus 40L backpack

name: Kahakka 25L backpack
description: 25-litre fold-top patrol daypack in 1000D and 500D Cordura with two pleated 3-litre side pouches, a radio/hydration compartment with cable ports, a 50 mm Berg buckle belt and a removable foam sitting pad. NSN 8465-58-002-0196.

name: Kahakka 15L backpack
description: 15-litre fold-top daypack in 1000D and 500D Cordura with two pleated 2.5-litre side pouches, a radio/hydration compartment with cable ports, contoured padded shoulder straps and a removable foam sitting pad. NSN 8465-58-002-0195.

name: Niukka 20L backpack
description: Minimalist 20-litre 500D Cordura daypack with a full clamshell zipper opening, a full-width exterior zip compartment, two internal mesh pockets, a hydration sleeve with side tube ports and G-hook compression straps.

name: Hatka 12L backpack
description: 12-litre 500D Cordura roll-top daypack with an SR buckle closure, detachable low-profile 25 mm shoulder straps, exterior PALS webbing and a 25 x 37 cm external back compartment.

name: Medic pack 18L
description: 18-litre dedicated medical pack in 1000D and 500D Cordura, loop-lined inside the top compartment, with a large front pocket, a separate bottom compartment, top and side carry handles, PALS webbing and drainage grommets. NSN 8465-58-002-0441.

name: Keikka 80L duffle bag
description: 80-litre 1000D Cordura duffel with wrap-around carry handles, hauling handles at both ends, a removable shoulder strap, harness attachment points, a zippered organiser side pouch and four flat hook-and-loop side pouches. NSN 8465-58-002-0192.

name: Keikka 50L duffle bag
description: 50-litre 1000D Cordura duffel with wrap-around carry handles, end hauling handles, a removable shoulder strap, harness attachment points, a zippered organiser side pouch and replaceable lid and bottom padding. NSN 8465-58-002-0191.

name: Keikka 30L duffle bag
description: 30-litre 1000D Cordura duffel with wrap-around carry handles, end hauling handles, a removable shoulder strap, harness attachment points, a zippered organiser side pouch and two internal mesh compartments. NSN 8465-58-002-0190.

name: Askare hip pack
description: 7-litre 500D Cordura hip pack on its own 40 mm SR buckle belt (70-144 cm) with stabilising wings, closed-cell foam body-side padding, a 35 x 10 cm interior loop panel and 2 x 2 PALS on each side. NSN 8465-58-002-0197.

name: Suur-kukkaro hip pack
description: 2.6-litre 500D Cordura hip pack on its own 25 mm SR buckle belt with stabilising wings, a zippered main compartment, three elastic organiser loops, a 20 x 10 cm interior loop panel and PALS on the wings and bottom.

name: Kukkaro hip pack
description: 1.5-litre 500D Cordura hip pack on its own 25 mm SR buckle belt (48-144 cm) with stabilising wings, one large and two small internal flat compartments, an 18 x 10 cm interior loop panel and PALS on the wings and bottom.

name: Rintamus chest pack
description: 2.6-litre 500D Cordura chest pack supplied with its own X-harness, a 3D mesh body-side compartment, a zippered main compartment with three elastic organiser loops and a 20 x 10 cm interior loop panel.

name: CARRY ESSENTIALS Commuter Pack
description: Our Commuter Pack is a low-profile backpack perfect for everyday use. Your new best friend that goes with you wherever you go - from the grocery shop to the park with a stop at the office and back. With its perfect fit, you might forget that the pack is always with you - wherever you go.

name: CARRY ESSENTIALS Compression Bag
description: The new Compression Bag is a breathable alternative to our waterproof Kit Bag. By allowing air to escape, the contents can be compressed as small as possible and, unlike waterproof pack sacks, is also suitable for damp or dirty clothing.

name: CARRY ESSENTIALS Dopp Kit Better Half
description: The Dopp Kit Better Half is just like the regular Dopp Kit, only with one compartment less. It can be used as a wash bag or also as a technical bag for storing electronic accessories and cables.

name: CARRY ESSENTIALS Grooming Kit
description: Our unique Dopp Kit offers full and easy access to all compartments, whether it is free standing or hanging. It can be used as a wash bag or even as a technical bag to store electronic accessories and cables.

name: CARRY ESSENTIALS Kit Bag V2
description: The Kit Bag is a roll-top pack that converts into an ultra-light and packable backpack when needed.

name: CARRY ESSENTIALS Neck Pouch (A5)
description: This is our interpretation of a classic chest bag. Everything you need within reach and always available. Thanks to its special mix of materials, the Neck Pouch A5 is flexible, robust and environmentally friendly.

name: CARRY ESSENTIALS Neck Pouch (A6)
description: This is our interpretation of a classic chest bag. Everything you need within reach and always available. Thanks to its special mix of materials, the Neck Pouch A6 is flexible, robust and environmentally friendly.

name: CARRY ESSENTIALS Packing Cubes
description: The Packing Cubes make your travel experience easier, more efficient and more sustainable. They ensure smart organization and fit perfectly in your luggage - for less chaos and more overview. The three Packing Cubes have a zippered compartment - ideal for up to five sets of T-shirts, underwear and socks. Compared to the previous model, we have focused on optimized functionality and even more robust materials.

name: CARRY ESSENTIALS Packing Cubes XL
description: The Packing Cubes make your travel experience easier, more efficient and more sustainable. They provide smart organization and fit perfectly in your luggage - for less chaos and more overview. As an extension of our organizer range, we are now presenting the Packing Cubes XL. They come as a set with one light and one dark cube. Ideal for larger items such as shoes, jackets or for separating dirty laundry.

name: CARRY ESSENTIALS Simple Pouch
description: Our Simple Pouch is not only simple and versatile, but also durable. A pencil case is a useful accessory for keeping pens and other writing utensils safe and within easy reach. Our Simple Pouch is also ideal for storing cables, chargers and other small items on the go.

name: CARRY ESSENTIALS Simple Pouch Mono 1L
description: The Simple Pouch, now available in our unique DYECOSHELL™ MONO material. It's durable, protects your essentials and is fully recyclable. It is available in Diamond Black and Ocean Blue, both in 1L and 2L versions.

name: CARRY ESSENTIALS Simple Pouch Mono 2L
description: The Simple Pouch, now available in our unique DYECOSHELL™ MONO material. It's durable, protects your essentials and is fully recyclable. It is available in Diamond Black and Ocean Blue, both in 1L and 2L versions.

name: MONOLITH Backpack 45+L
description: The Monolith backpack is perfect for everyday use, but also for longer trips. Thanks to the M.O.L.L.E. system, the versatile 45-litre backpack offers flexible expansion options, numerous adjustment options and an ergonomic carrying system - ideal for travelers and backpackers. The aluminum frame and hip belt can be removed, making the backpack a practical everyday companion.

name: MONOLITH MINIMAL 18L Pack
description: The MINIMAL backpack is exactly what it claims to be. Reduced to the essentials, this 18-litre backpack offers space for all your everyday essentials without being distracting. There are 3 pockets at the bottom on the front to help you keep everything within reach and well organised.

name: MONOLITH Weekender 40L
description: The weekender is the perfect all-in-one solution. With a volume of 40 liters, it meets the maximum hand luggage dimensions and can be taken on any plane. Thanks to the stowable backpack straps and the included shoulder strap, you can choose whether you want to carry it as a backpack or messenger bag.

name: MOTION Arc 20L
description: The Motion Arc backpack was developed for the widest possible range of activities. A mix of functional elements and innovative materials creates a unique concept that focuses on mobility. Optionally, a laptop or hydration bladder can be stowed in the backpack. With its lightweight and versatile design, the Motion Arc Backpack is made for an active lifestyle on the move - for every day and every trip.

name: MOTION Ellipse 25L
description: The Motion Ellipse backpack in the colour "Dark", as part of the MOTION series, was developed for a wide range of activities.
